lesson: The system is consistently attempting to fade momentum or catch reversals in a high-velocity trend, resulting in 4 consecutive stop-outs. Relying on local RSI oversold conditions or minor CHoCH patterns within a dominant bearish macro structure has proven ineffective as the price continues to expand into lower liquidity zones.
adjustment: Implement a strict 'Trend-Filter' rule: ignore all long setups until the price closes above the 50 EMA on the 1H timeframe, and avoid shorting into extreme oversold RSI levels without a confirmed bearish retest of a broken support level.
methodology_flag: Trust local SMC reversal patterns less when the macro trend is in a strong markdown phase.
